title-group.article-title: Hippocampal Theta Oscillations During Spatial Navigation

abstract.p: We recorded hippocampal local field potentials in freely moving mice during a spatial navigation task.
Theta-band power scaled with running speed and predicted place-cell firing, supporting a role for theta in spatial coding.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: The hippocampus supports spatial memory. This paragraph introduces theta oscillations with an inline references.
Place cells fire selectively when an animal occupies a location.

sec.title: Background
sec.p: Prior work linked theta rhythm to memory encoding in the entorhinal cortex.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We implanted silicon probes in area CA1 and recorded from freely moving mice during a linear-track task.

caption.p: Recording setup and example theta-filtered LFP trace from CA1.
Mean theta frequency and power across running-speed bins.

ref.mixed-citation: O'Keefe, J. and Nadel, L. The Hippocampus as a Cognitive Map. Oxford, 1978. 10.1000/okeefe.1978

ref.element-citation: Buzsaki, G. Theta oscillations in the hippocampus. Neuron, 2002.
